notices.short_title: Chromebooks
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded Compulink Technologies Inc a $103,208 contract for Chromebooks through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.

notices.short_title: BEPA Dell Laptops 6060253X

notices.short_title: BWT Hot Water Heater 6XC00306

notices.short_title: Congregate Housing
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene renewed its contract with CAMBA, Inc. for congregate housing services, at $8.2 million.

notices.short_title: NYPD Emblems (Embroidered)

notices.short_title: Virtual reality training simulator
notices.plain: The Police Department renewed its contract with V-Armed, Inc. for a virtual reality training simulator, at a cost of $440,000.

notices.short_title: Roofs/Flood Elimination/Exterior Masonry/Parapets / Electrification/Electrical Service Upgrade/Lighting Upgrade/Fire Alarm Upgrade

notices.short_title: Furnishing and Installing Accessible Pedestrian Signals, Staten Island, Area #5
